slides.narration: When it comes to diabetes, most of us know there are two types: type 1, type 2. The way I always remember type 2 is that you're too fat. And it's more than just simply being too fat, but that's what we tend to talk about. As you can see in the chart, there's a lot more type 2 diabetes than there is type 1. Now, there is a third type of diabetes, which is basically women who are pregnant who get elevated glucose levels during pregnancy. But for most of us, we tend to think of only type 1 and type 2. Those of you who are going into the allied health fields, you'll might even discuss up to five different types of diabetes. But for us, for this class, type 1, type 2, and remember type 2 is because you're too fat. As I always like to do, give you a little hints to help you remember things.
